test_title: PYST 12: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the son of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A x B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is D related to J if ‘D ÷ F x G – H + J’?
solution:
A + B → A is the son of B

A − B → A is the brother of B

A × B → A is the wife of B

A ÷ B → A is the father of B

Relation: D ÷ F × G − H + J

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0a412cae5b98c3f472a0aa10194cb9364632a16bc307dad52a44d450cb38007.png] 

Decode relation from left → right

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a886f203392fc98281b1bd642d24621f71bfdb140e1cce8baa526ad93e7f82.png] 

**∴ D is the father-in-law of J’s son.**

Hence the correct answer is** Option 3.**
